> Agriculture is navigating growing complexity — one where data has become central to understanding soils, fields, and production systems.

This site is a space for analysis and reflection on agri-environmental issues, agricultural data interpretation, and structured approaches to decision-making.

## Key topics

:::::: {.grid .g-4}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### Agro-environment

Soil management, drainage, within-field variability, and adaptation to changing climatic conditions.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### Data analysis

Interpretation methods, information organization, and critical reading of results.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### Decision support

Analytical approaches to inform agronomic decisions at the field scale.
:::
::::::
